easyPrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using The Sixth Doctor this turn.
description:
Cast Gideon by paying {4}{W}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying the Gideon spell, with the copy being nonlegendary.
Resolve both Gideon spells.
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Gideon token.
Activate a Gideon token's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.
